Few experiences in saltwater fly fishing compare to the thrill of targeting tarpon in the Florida Keys. blurb: StayFly Inshore Fishing offers customized guided fly fishing trips in Islamorada and the Everglades, targeting Tarpon, Bonefish, Permit, Redfish, and Snook. Trips are tailored to all skill levels and focus on connecting anglers with iconic saltwater fisheries. The guide has over 15 years of professional experience and 30 years fishing the Florida Keys and Everglades.
